svg.title: Scenario 4: Player Turn — Warrior Uses Shield Bash, Stunning Goblin

g.text: Scenario 4: Player Turn — Warrior Uses Shield Bash, Stunning Goblin
Scenarios 4 and 5 occur in the same executePlayerTurn() call.
Warrior (SPD=30) acts first → Shield Bash stuns Goblin.
Goblin (SPD=25) acts second → is stunned, skips (Scenario 5).
DefendBuff from Scenario 2 is still active entering this round (turns=2→1 here).
Only fires if skill is not on cooldown.
Goblin phase follows next in this same call.
Goblin is stunned — see Scenario 5 for that detail.
